description: Retry a failed scheduled post, optionally editing the content, narrowing to failed platforms, rescheduling, or publishing immediately.

mediaUrl.description: Replacement public HTTPS media URL for the retry.

mediaUrls.description: Replacement public HTTPS media URLs for the retry.

platforms.description: Optional subset of failed platforms to retry.

publishNow.description: Publish the retry immediately instead of scheduling it.

scheduledAt.description: New ISO 8601 retry time. Required unless publishNow is true.

team_id.description: Team ID to operate in team scope. Get available teams with list_teams. If omitted, uses personal scope.

text.description: Replacement post text for the retry.

name: retry_scheduled_post
title: Retry Scheduled Post
